title: Count in 2s, 5s and 10s
summary: Count in fives, twos and tens. Continue a count, find a missing number and count groups.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 counts 15 blocks in fives. Child thinks 5, 10, 15. Q2 continues 20, 25, 30. Q3 finds 16 in a twos gap. Q4 counts groups of 5 in 20 blocks. Q5 fills 45 on a hundred square counting in fives. Q6 counts hops of 5 to the mark at 15. Q7 matches 10 to two groups of 5 on a ten frame. Q8 picks two tens-count numbers. Q9 counts 3 children holding up one hand each. Q10 orders 35, 40, 45, 50.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy uses pairs and tens pictures up to 50, with hops on the number line. Medium adds fives, a twos gap, a tens pick and higher 5s counts. Hard names the step size, counts back, spots a number you would not say, and orders from biggest to smallest. Hard is a new kind of thinking, not just bigger numbers.
